Title: Developer tool enhancements for Azure Blockchain Development Kit for Ethereum

Body.Content:
Today we are announcing enhancements to the Azure Blockchain Development Kit for Ethereum to provide integration with new capabilities for public and private Ethereum developers. These include Open Zeppelin integration for easy discoverability and use of popular smart contracts for common developer needs. Additionally, we are adding native Infura integration to make it easy to create and interact with Infura projects and deploy to Infura endpoints. Read more about this announcement on our Open Source blog.

Read the announcement on our Open Source blog
